meta.source: Known World Wireframes (artifact MBtBBnZymhk4B1LdQdN4aB), page CSS and SVG palette

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The only theme: the board is dark by choice.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the stage, the zone legend, anatomy figures.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Inside the frame: the 1920×1080 wireframe and every SVG drawing. Darker than bg so the frame reads as a screen.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Water between continents on the map.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, table rules, toggle-group outline, the pressed-button fill.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: A stronger rule where two surfaces meet. Not for text (2.2:1).

tokens.name: frame-line
tokens.usage: Inside the frame: the dashed zone outlines and axis lines.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel and canvas (16.5:1 on bg).

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the subtitle, legend copy, captions, unpressed buttons (8:1 on bg).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels: table heads, control labels, notes. FLAG: 4.1:1 on bg and 3.9:1 on panel, under 4.5:1 for its 11–13px uses; kept from the source. Use frame-muted where legibility matters.

tokens.name: frame-muted
tokens.usage: Annotation text inside the frame and drawings (5.6:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Inside the frame: empty bar tracks, lane rails, a faded ticker. Never text.

tokens.name: land
tokens.usage: Known land: the hex tiles of a continent.

tokens.name: land-dim
tokens.usage: Land not yet warm: distant islands, the current layout's corner land.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber. The annotator's pen on the board: the hot zone, recommendations, focus rings, numbered rows. Board only; it never appears inside the film frame and is never a nation.

tokens.name: nation-human
tokens.usage: Nation: human. Bone, the warm neutral: you, before and alongside the machines. Swatches, blooms, commits below the band line. 13.5:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: nation-chatgpt
tokens.usage: Nation: ChatGPT. Green, the first outside voice; chatter above the band line, rings from the void. Darker than human so the two separate by lightness for colour-blind viewers (9:1).

tokens.name: nation-claude
tokens.usage: Nation: Claude. Coral. Blooms, model chips, MIRV connectors (7.8:1).

tokens.name: nation-codex
tokens.usage: Nation: Codex. Blue, moved off cyan so it no longer sits beside ChatGPT's green. Beams and blooms (5.9:1).

tokens.name: nation-auto
tokens.usage: Nation: automation (CI, bots, scripts). Magenta, moved off amber so it never reads as an annotation (6.4:1).

tokens.name: nation-local
tokens.usage: Nation: local models, the protagonist. The brightest hue in the system, so a local test is the hottest flash on the map (15.9:1). Shares a yellow cast with accent; accent never appears inside the frame.

tokens.name: nation-oc
tokens.usage: Nation: OC. Lavender, lighter than Codex blue so the two stay apart for colour-blind viewers (10.4:1).

tokens.name: surface-github
tokens.usage: Surface: GitHub (repos risen). Sage. Swatch, coast label and a 1px coast edge on its land; land tiles stay land. Surfaces are terrain: low chroma, mid lightness, never as loud as a nation.

tokens.name: surface-linux
tokens.usage: Surface: linux. Moss.

tokens.name: surface-e
tokens.usage: Surface: E: drive. Steel; the darkest surface (4.9:1).

tokens.name: surface-c
tokens.usage: Surface: C: drive. Slate, the lightest grey.

tokens.name: surface-am4
tokens.usage: Surface: AM4 rig. Heather.

tokens.name: surface-fx99
tokens.usage: Surface: FX99. Umber.

tokens.name: zone-hot
tokens.usage: Fill of the selected zone in the frame, under an accent 2px outline.

families.sans: "Source Sans 3", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: kw-section
styles.usage: Section heads, uppercase, in fg-2. Numbered with a middle dot.

styles.name: kw-panel-title
styles.usage: Legend and panel titles, in accent.

styles.name: kw-control
styles.usage: Buttons and segments: 13px on touch, 12px with a fine pointer. Also recommendations.

styles.name: kw-label
styles.usage: Table heads, control labels, definition terms. Uppercase, in muted.

styles.name: kw-ticker-p
styles.usage: Portrait frame (the primary): the date ticker, line one of the ticker strip.

styles.name: kw-ticker
styles.usage: Landscape frame: the date ticker, top-left.

styles.name: kw-count
styles.usage: A nation's test count in a full row, right-aligned. 28px on phones, 30px from bp-sm.

styles.name: kw-body
styles.usage: Body copy and rules lists, max 80ch.

styles.name: kw-small
styles.sample: The timeline zone: one horizontal axis.
styles.usage: Legend copy and figure captions, in fg-2.

styles.name: kw-note
styles.sample: A change here is a recompile in seconds.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inset of a segmented control's group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between segments; table-head padding nudge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between zone buttons; legend title margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; control-row gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; legend dl column gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Stage and figure padding; section-head bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Legend padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; strip side padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between board columns and anatomy figures.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page side gutter from bp-sm (phones use space-16); phone top padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Page top padding from bp-sm.

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: Space above a section head.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and the frame inside a stage.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, the stage, toggle groups.

layout.note: Mobile first. Portrait (p-*) is the primary frame for the player and the export; landscape is the desktop enhancement. Breakpoints and touch sizes come first.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: First enhancement: tables become tables, nation rows go two-up, controls sit in one row.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every control on touch. Mouse users (pointer: fine) get the compact size.

tokens.name: p-frame-w
tokens.usage: Portrait export width (9:16). The player lays out at 360 CSS px wide and renders at 3x.

tokens.name: p-frame-h
tokens.usage: Portrait export height. At 360-wide layout this is 640 CSS px.

tokens.name: p-ticker-h
tokens.usage: Portrait ticker: the date on line one, rate and totals on line two (CSS px at 360 wide).

tokens.name: p-strip-h
tokens.usage: Portrait nation strip: swatch + test count per nation, one tap target tall.

tokens.name: p-timeline-h
tokens.usage: Portrait timeline, closed: ruler 24 + band 60. Lanes stay folded.

tokens.name: p-timeline-open
tokens.usage: Portrait timeline with lanes open (tap the band). It grows up over the map, which never re-centres.

tokens.name: p-map-min
tokens.usage: Map height at 360×640 with everything closed: 70% of the frame.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of main.

tokens.name: legend-width
tokens.usage: The zone legend beside the stage from bp-lg; full width beneath it below.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Second enhancement: the board goes two-column, legend beside the stage. Also where the landscape frame becomes the default in the player.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length of rules and prose (the subtitle uses 70ch).

tokens.name: l-frame-w
tokens.usage: Landscape frame width (desktop enhancement, 16:9 export).

tokens.name: l-frame-h
tokens.usage: Landscape frame height.

tokens.name: ticker-h
tokens.usage: Ticker strip; 84px once the totals line exists.

tokens.name: nations-w
tokens.usage: Nation panel, right edge, rendered only with a nation.

tokens.name: timeline-h
tokens.usage: Timeline zone: ruler 24 + band 60 + lanes 116.

tokens.name: ruler-h
tokens.usage: The ruler and scrubber.

tokens.name: band-h
tokens.usage: The mirrored chatter/commit band.

tokens.name: lane-h
tokens.usage: One lineage lane; ten fit.

tokens.name: nation-row
tokens.usage: A nation row at seven nations or fewer; 96px from the eighth.

tokens.name: bloom-halo
tokens.usage: Outer disc of a test bloom.

tokens.name: bloom-core
tokens.usage: Inner disc of a test bloom, 45% of the halo radius.

tokens.name: beam
tokens.usage: Launch beams and lane branch rails.
